mainFindings: main's support DTO carries origin: null on every download, so a colleague cannot tell which build produced the file. inspectRuntimeIdentity supplies that evidence; main must wire it.
The support and download envelopes still do not verify their own sha256 (the contract checks shape only); G's port does the cryptographic check and reports mismatch.
The served header coverageState still folds a partial row into 'partial' for a completely enumerated source, so every support report says 'the observation is partial'.
The install manifest embeds the full inventory (~1.46 MB); a small parse guard made identity look absent earlier, so the guard is 8 MiB with an explicit manifestState.
